race.comment: LUCAND MAGIC (5) never gave them a look in on debut when he led all the way to score as favourite over 1000m at Wyong. Has scope for further upside from the inside gate. PUNXSUTAWNEY PHIL (12) heavily supported on debut as the ($1.60 fav) with a slick 3 len victory over 1100m at Scone on a rain affected track. Can take the next step in this grade and gets his chance with Lloyd aboard. ST JOHANN (4) started a dominant fav on debut and ran accordingly with a comfortable Maiden win over 1150m at Beaumont (Newcastle). Keep safe in the small field from the awkward gate.DRAGON BLOOD (11) bounced off his good debut second, with a fighting on pace win over 1200m at Wyong in a Super Maiden. Don't dismiss.
